name: hidx_score_qe_1018-ref-COMMIT
purpose: IDX quarter scorer glue tile (wires-only quarter ot_hbm_idx_score_quarter_wo, x4 per die)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_idx_score_qe_static u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/index/quad_1017/ot_hbm_idx_score_quarter_split.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hbm_accel/index/hidx_meta_w25_d123_r0.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay_rf.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hbm_idx_owned_native.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_arith_lat.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_arith.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hidx_score_qe_1018/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hidx_score_qe_1018/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hidx_score_qe_1018 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hbm_idx_score_qe_static  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: OWN-IDXSCORE 2026-10-18: E glue column of the wires-only IDX quarter scorer: both rows' E glue verbatim (keep delay D106, settle/online fault, ot_hbm_idx_tail_native, d123 meta RF), own reset relay, registered score (306 b) + fault; one clock (the E region clock). TW3-IDXSCORE 10-19: W face re-pinned to the leaf (e,3) E pins: r0_* in the bottom row section, r1_* in the top, each port at its leaf E-face range (shared leaf face table).
